notes: Proved in Lean with ChebyshevT(v,x) = cosh(v arcosh x), x >= 1 (Mathlib Real.arcosh; equals the Chebyshev polynomial for integer v): for n >= 1, T(n/2,n) is not an integer iff n odd and (n+1)/2 not a square (A173263_main), and the set is infinite (A173263_infinite), so the finiteness conjecture is false. Odd n = 2m+1: arcosh n = 2 arcosh sqrt(m+1), T(n/2,n) = T_n(sqrt(m+1)) = sqrt(m+1) w with w a nonzero integer. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.
